summary: Dream Finders Homes filed an 8-K reporting a reincorporation from Delaware to Texas, effective June 9, 2026, with no changes to business, management, assets, liabilities, or listed securities. Each existing share of Class A and Class B common stock converted automatically on a one-for-one basis into shares of the Texas corporation. The board approved a new form of indemnification agreement for directors and officers. This is a routine jurisdictional change and does not constitute a special situation event. No deal terms or premium are applicable.
